gen-gf-tektur-gf-sarpanch: Tektur looks like bent pipe cleaner, its curves left wide open at every terminal and its lowercase oddly oversized. Sarpanch, a plain sans, tucks in beneath with a compact, friendly build, so a long read feels approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-savate: Savate is a plain sans with sturdy hairlines, open jaws on its curves and a tall round o that nearly matches the capital. Tektur, drawn at one thickness like cable, sits above it and keeps the page lively.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-sen: Sen cuts its tall lowercase from strips of equal width, with curves that stop before turning inward. Metamorphous is best at softly swelling strokes and generous sidebearings, while Sen is best at plain, uniform lines.
gen-gf-offside-gf-sintony: Curves that refuse to close, spaced wide, with no thinning anywhere, make Offside quietly commanding up top. Sintony, a plain sans with a chunky tall midzone, does the smooth everyday reading while Offside makes the statement.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-sofia-sans: A high x-height makes Oxanium's lowercase look big, and its monoline curves end in clear daylight. Sofia Sans, a sans-serif with rounded, tall letters and no thick-thin modulation, takes over for the steady reading work.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-sofia-sans-semi-conden: Sofia Sans Semi Condensed holds one unbroken line weight, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Paprika scatters its big letters far apart above it, and you can give the sans-serif body a little more size.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-sono: Sono spaces its tall lowercase generously, each a left slightly ajar, which gives the sans a friendly stride. Revalia loosens things further above it, with an open-curved g and widely separated letters, and the two feel relaxed together.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-stack-sans-notch: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges between tall lowercase letters and openings like a sprung paper clip. Stack Sans Notch, a plain sans of rod-stock strokes, lets a long read run smooth and open.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-stack-sans-headline: Tektur bends its strokes like pipe cleaner, with open terminals and oversized lowercase that stand out at once. Stack Sans Headline, a sans with a monoline skeleton and a deep middle band, keeps a long read crisp and approachable.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-pt-sans-caption: PT Sans Caption reads inviting, with unclosed bowls and big-bodied lowercase that feel easy on the eye as a plain sans. Funnel Display adds cord-like rounded strokes up top.
